metadata.Description: Bold is an exploration of minimalist aesthetics, where visual complexity is achieved through simplicity. Using only two colors and two basic patterns, the artwork plays with geometric shapes and contrasts to create a rich and impactful composition. Digitally designed with JavaScript and the p5.js library, each composition is later brought to life on canvas using acrylic paint, blending the digital with the physical. Bold celebrates the power of simplicity as a creative tool to generate intense and deeply aesthetic visual experiences.

metadata.Description: Harmonia is a generative artwork that explores the intrinsic relationship between movement and mathematics. Through trigonometric functions, the piece reveals how seemingly organic and unpredictable patterns are governed by an underlying order. Using a dynamic and oscillating grid, Harmonia illustrates that dynamism is not chaotic but a precise expression of mathematical equations. This project aims to demonstrate that the beauty of movement lies in its structure, a universal language that connects the abstract with the tangible, logic with emotion.

metadata.Medium: Photography using Meta Ray Ban Glasses
metadata.Description:
EyeLens is a visionary artist based in the United States, capturing the breathtaking beauty of landscapes during travels across the nation through the innovative use of Meta Ray Ban glasses. With a deep appreciation for the magic of sunrises and sunsets over tranquil waters, EyeLens finds inspiration in the ephemeral moments that nature offers.
Employing recursion during the inscription process, EyeLens crafts dynamic photographic images. This approach, although still emerging in the photography realm of Bitcoin Ordinals, offers a unique avenue for artists to transition their finest creations to the Bitcoin blockchain, showcasing the limitless potential of digital art.
Committed to making a difference, EyeLens is dedicated to allocating a portion of minting funds to support grassroots charities that directly assist veterans, the homeless, and individuals facing mental health challenges. Recommendations for impactful organizations are always welcome, as EyeLens seeks to connect with those in need and amplify their stories, fostering awareness and positive change. With a vision of leveraging Bitcoin and Ordinals for good, EyeLens believes in the transformative power of art to create a brighter future.

I am thrilled to present my inaugural collection of Bitcoin Ordinals, a vibrant exploration of my artistic journey. Captured exclusively with Meta Ray Ban glasses during enchanting trips to Hawaii and Key West in early fall of 2024, this collection serves as both a practical test of my creative process and a glimpse into the beauty of the world through my lens.
The pieces in this collection predominantly feature breathtaking natural landscapes, showcasing the ethereal beauty of sunrises and sunsets over tranquil waters. Each image reflects a moment of serenity, inviting viewers to immerse themselves in the vivid colors and the harmonious interplay of light and water. The stories behind these works are woven into the inscription data, providing insight and context to the viewer.
Among these works is a special piece that encapsulates a cherished memory, a stunning photograph from my wife and I's unforgettable journey to the summit of Mauna Kea. This experience was not only awe-inspiring but also deeply personal, adding a layer of intimacy to the collection.
As I embark on this artistic venture, I invite you to join me in exploring the techniques and visions that will shape my future collections. This is just the beginning, and I am excited to share these moments with you.

metadata.Bio: Thomas is a generative artist who creates his works using code. With a bachelor's degree in mechatronics, he works as an engineer in the automotive industry and lives in Austria with his wife and two children. His artistic journey began in September 2021 when he decided to invest in cryptocurrencies. While researching, he discovered NFTs, which ignited his interest in art. This curiosity led him to download free drawing programs and experiment with his first creations. Eventually, Thomas encountered artificial intelligence, which unlocked new possibilities for his art. Immersing himself in AI, he established himself as an AI artist, with his works showcased in physical galleries worldwide, including venues in New York City, France, Rome, and Austria. At the start of 2023, Thomas discovered generative art and developed a passion for coding. Since then, he has devoted every spare moment to refining his coding skills and creating generative art.

metadata.Title: Jesters in Love
metadata.Tale:
The Court of the Crimson Moon

In a jester’s kingdom under a mischievous crimson moon, Quibble and Marotte danced through life, hiding their love behind jokes and acrobatics. Quibble’s tear-painted eye sparkled with mischief, while Marotte’s crooked hat tilted like his riddles. They loved in secret, for love in their world was a forbidden punchline—those caught were banished to the dreadful Land of Serious Things.

But the moon had its own sense of humor. One night, during a grand performance, it cracked open, bathing the jesters in a glowing light that unveiled their secret. The court gasped as Marotte clasped Quibble’s hand, and her bells chimed like a confession.

Then came the voice of the crimson moon itself, whispering down: "Tell me, fools, what do you think love is—comedy or tragedy?"

Quibble’s tear-painted eye shimmered. “Both,” she replied. “It’s falling off a tightrope and laughing because you were never meant to walk straight in the first place.”

Marotte grinned. “It’s juggling chaos and never dropping the heart, even when the world demands you do.”

The moon chuckled, its crack sealing back into a perfect glowing sphere. “Then let the jesters love as they will.” With that, the world shifted. No exile, no shame—only applause that turned into fireworks made of giggling stars.

Quibble and Marotte embraced as their kingdom transformed. From that night on, they were free to perform their most daring act yet: loving without masks, under the ever-watchful eye of the crimson moon.

And when they kissed for the first time, the bells in Quibble’s boots laughed, echoing endlessly through the surreal lands of dreams.

metadata.Name: Longform Generative Art
metadata.Description: This is the child inscription of Th0mas Art for Longform Generative Art projects.

Synesthesis is a generative art experiment that merges synthesis and synesthesia: forms and colors are arranged within defined structures, interacting in a way that each execution gives rise to new visual relationships. The elements follow precise rules, creating a composition that transforms perception and generates shifting visual experiences, where the layering of patterns and colors redefines how they are observed. Inspired by synesthesia, this project explores how the mind interprets form and color when they merge into a dynamic structure.

You can restart the composition by pressing R, allowing you to explore new possibilities.

metadata.name: QUANTUM ANXIETY
metadata.description: A quantum-inspired generative artwork that visualizes Bitcoin blockchain data through wave interference patterns and probabilistic text effects. The piece reflects both technological uncertainty and market dynamics through interactive wave patterns, quantum fluctuations, and real-time blockchain data visualization. The text 'QUANTUM ANXIETY' appears to exist in multiple states simultaneously, affected by blockchain activity and subjected to occasional quantum decoherence events.

block_time.influence: Speed and complexity of interference patterns

merkle_root.method: Triadic color harmony from root segments

metadata.artist_statement: QUANTUM ANXIETY explores the intersection of quantum uncertainty and market psychology in the Bitcoin ecosystem. Created during Bitcoin's approach to $100,000 and amid quantum computing advances, the piece reflects both the excitement and nervousness within the crypto space. Through wave interference patterns and probabilistic effects, it visualizes the delicate balance between technological progress and market sentiment.
metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork automatically updates with each new Bitcoin block. Wave patterns respond to network activity, while text exhibits quantum-inspired fluctuations. Circuit-style corners display real-time blockchain data.

metadata.description:
“imaAIgination | O” is a generative algorithmic abstract artwork animation, released in a limited edition of 20. It harnesses randomness, motion-based dynamics, and procedural aesthetics to visualize the very essence of creativity – the beautiful chaos of sparking thoughts and ideas.

“imaAIgination | O” captures the dynamic emergence of algorithmic imagination and human creativity. Each flicker, burst, and intersecting line reflects the energy of inspiration as it unfolds – where randomness transforms into structured thought, and chaos evolves into pure innovation.

The composition evokes a neural symphony – dots scatter like firing neurons, radiating lines expand like cosmic explosions of thought, illustrating the interconnected nature of ideas in an ever-expanding creative universe.

Crafted through an innovative collaboration between the artist, JOiFULLiWi, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence, this work represents a fusion of human intuition and machine precision. The result is an artwork that feels both organic and computational, standing as a testament to the boundless possibilities of Generative Algorithmic Creativity, and the synergized collaboration between human and AI.

The on-chain artifact status as Ordinal of “imaAIgination | O” is reflected in its design making it an exclusive art piece within the Generative Algorithmic Art Series #1, alongside the high-resolution artworks (NFTs) released on the Ethereum Blockchain. This cross-chain synergy ensures the artwork's legacy across two pioneering digital art ecosystems — Ethereum for high-resolution collectibility and Bitcoin for immutable, highly valuable on-chain exclusivity.

As an on-chain artifact inscribed as a Bitcoin Ordinal, 'imaAIgination | O' embodies exclusivity within the Generative Algorithmic Art Series #1. This unique piece is based on and exists alongside its high-resolution Ethereum NFT counterparts, creating a powerful cross-chain synergy. While Ethereum ensures high-resolution collectibility, Bitcoin preserves the artwork as an immutable, on-chain relic of generative art, solidifying its value across two pioneering digital art ecosystems.
metadata.edition_and_blockchain_distribution: This generative algorithmic abstract artwork animation, “imaAIgination | O”, is part of a limited edition of 20 inscribed Ordinals on the Bitcoin Blockchain, making it a fully on-chain digital artifact. Due to Bitcoin's storage limitations, these Ordinal editions are exclusive, highly valuable low-resolution on-chain artifacts, permanently inscribed on Bitcoin.

metadata.Author's Note: Caballero's Book Sculptures are an eight-part series that questions how society values poetry. This series proposes the book as a sculptural object, and will see Caballero print eight different books, each as an edition of one, with a unique ISBN and the anatomy and structure of a traditional book.  The books in this series contain only one poem, printed 197 times in their pages. When taken as integers, the digits in 197 add up eventually to 8, a number that represents abundance.  Developed with a bespoke book binder, the works in this series are stunning objects yet remain very authentically books, with a table of contents, an author page and a dedication, which is hand-signed and dedicated to its collector.  The collector of the physical 1/1 book receives a 1/1 video work of a single page of the book endlessly turning while Caballero reads the poem in addition to an inscription of the poem onto the Bitcoin blockchain, accentuating the artist's expansion of the ways poetry can be experienced, exhibited, recorded and transacted in the digital age.

Working with a bespoke book binder to design every element, the works in this series are stunning objects yet remain very authentically books, with a table of contents, an author page and a dedication, which is hand-signed and dedicated to its collector.  This inscription is accompanied by a physical book and a video that shows a single page of the book endlessly turning while Caballero reads the text, accentuating the artist's expansion of the ways poetry can be experienced, exhibited and transacted in the digital age.  Caballero's Book Sculptures celebrate the materiality of poetry and the renewed cultural agency afforded to verse via blockchain provenance.

metadata.Title: Greetings from Marfa
metadata.Description:
On November 15, 2024, Gamma.io hosted 'An Ordinal Evening in Marfa' at Alta Marfa Wine Bar in Marfa, TX. During the event, Gamma distributed three dozen disposable film cameras, inviting attendees to capture their experiences at Art Blocks Marfa Weekend. The photos were then developed and digitally scanned for collage artist Michelle Thompson, who collaborated with Gamma tech lead, Jack Napolitano, to create a fully on-chain, recursive collage photography collection. The final collection features 432 curated outputs—an homage to Marfa's area code.

Thanks to Michelle and the project's contributors, this collective experience is now permanently preserved on Bitcoin.

metadata.description: A dynamic, blockchain-responsive visualization that explores the quantum nature of Bitcoin's recent price milestone through electric fields and probabilistic flows. The artwork combines quantum-inspired visual effects with real-time blockchain data, creating an evolving composition where text elements interact with energy fields and particle systems. The quantum field shader creates electromagnetic-like effects that respond to network activity, while charge points trace the probabilistic paths of quantum particles.

metadata.artist_statement: QUANTUM LEAP visualizes Bitcoin's historic achievement of $100,000 through the lens of quantum mechanics, representing both the uncertainty and inevitability of this milestone. The artwork draws parallels between quantum phenomena and cryptocurrency markets, using electric fields and probability waves to express the complex dynamics of the Bitcoin network. As transaction volumes and fee rates fluctuate, the quantum field responds with varying intensities, creating a living visualization of network activity.
metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork automatically updates with new blocks. The quantum field responds to network activity, while charge points trace probabilistic paths around the text. Corner displays provide real-time blockchain metrics, with pulse effects indicating data updates.

metadata.Title: The Call
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block ~144 (approx) - On January 9, 2009, Satoshi Nakamoto published a call to action for developers, miners, and freedom enthusiasts to begin participating in the network, a genesis moment for the Bitcoin community.

metadata.Title: Source
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block (-) The publication of the Bitcoin white paper by Satoshi Nakamoto on October 31, 2008 introduced the concept of Bitcoin as a peer-to-peer electronic cash that could solve the problem of double-spending using a distributed ledger.

metadata.Title: The Genesis Block
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block 0 - Satoshi Nakamoto mined the first Bitcoin block on January 3, 2009, embedding a news headline about bank bailouts, symbolizing Bitcoin's purpose as an alternative financial system.

metadata.Title: Orange Wave
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block ~686,112 (approx) - El Salvador adopted Bitcoin as legal tender on June 9, 2021, becoming the first country to officially recognize Bitcoin as sound money. Later that year, they also began acquiring Bitcoin as a national reserve asset.

metadata.Title: Rune Tide Sailor
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block 840,000 -The fifth halving in April 2024 marked the launch of the Runes protocol and the introduction of a new way to create and trade tokens on Bitcoin using UTXO-based transactions and the OP_RETURN function to store data.

metadata.Title: Sold the House
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block 170 - The first documented Bitcoin transaction, when Satoshi Nakamoto sent BTC to Hal Finney on January 12, 2009, demonstrating Bitcoin's first use-case as a peer-to-peer electronic cash system.

metadata.Title: Inscriber 0
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block 767,430 - Inscription #0 was made by Casey Radamor, introducing Ordinals to Bitcoin sparking a new era for digital art on Bitcoin, turning the blockchain into an immutable canvas for creators.

metadata.Title: New Frontiers
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block 709,632 - Activation of the Taproot upgrade on November 14, 2021, the innovation that eventually made it possible to create the Ordinals protocol and set the stage for further innovations on the Bitcoin network.

Block 210,000 - This marked the first Bitcoin halving on November 28, 2012, when the block subsidy halved, sparking discussions around Bitcoin's economic model and security as block rewards approach zero and transition to a fee-based model.

metadata.Title: Bulls Awakening
metadata.Description and Historical Reference: Block ~800,000 (approx) - On January 10, 2024, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approved the first 11 bitcoin spot ETFs, ushering in the Bull market and sending Bitcoin to all-time highs.

metadata.technique: Generative art designed with JavaScript and p5.js, hand-painted in acrylic on canvas.
metadata.description: Alchemy is a project that transforms patterns, shapes, and colors into visual compositions filled with beauty. Inspired by the alchemical process of turning common materials into gold, this work seeks to create harmony through the precise and balanced interaction of its elements. The compositions are digitally generated using JavaScript and the p5.js library, then transferred to canvas with acrylic paint, merging the digital and physical worlds. Alchemy reveals that beauty lies in the harmonious relationship between its parts, inviting the viewer to discover how, through design, the abstract can become something sublime.

Inspired by the alchemical process of turning common materials into gold, this work seeks to create harmony through the precise and balanced interaction of its elements. The compositions are digitally generated using JavaScript and the p5.js library, then transferred to canvas with acrylic paint, merging the digital and physical worlds. Alchemy reveals that beauty lies in the harmonious relationship between its parts, inviting the viewer to discover how, through design, the abstract can become something sublime.

Recursive and interactive on-chain generative art inscribed on Palindromes. This is a collection of inscriptions embedded with art genes. All synthetic art generates a mirror-like parallel world with each tap on the screen.
Evolving, changing, and eventually fading over approximately 120 years, this work symbolizes the permanence and transition within the digital world.

The design is inspired by the visuals of analog synthesizers and integrates visual elements and sound based on blockchain data. Using the Sat number as a seed, the algorithm ensures each output is unique. By clicking, viewers trigger an electromagnetic pulse animation and an 8-bar sound loop. The artwork evolves in real-time, with patterns, colors, and sounds changing with each Bitcoin block. "Pulsar" represents the dynamic interplay between order and chaos, illustrating the constant evolution of technology and creativity, as well as the flow of energy and relationships in an electronic world.

"Ghost Echoes" rises from the digital depths, inviting you to meet a ghost shaped by your Sat number. This spirit occasionally follows your moves, flickering as it traces your gestures. Yet, as the blockchain’s heartbeat keeps ticking, this fleeting figure slowly fades away. In about 120 years, after 7,140,000 blocks are mined, all ghosts will drift into their eternal rest.

metadata.title: Cosimo De' Medici "Calcio Fiorentino" NFL
metadata.collection: Lorenzo De' Medici Private Art Collection - Family Heritage
metadata.description:
This Cosimo De' Medici XFT is an elevated digital and physical masterpiece that honors the Grand Duke of Tuscany's legacy as a patron of the arts, a military strategist, and an architect of Florence's dominance in the Renaissance. Prince Lorenzo De' Medici merges historical iconography with contemporary elements, showcasing Cosimo's vision, power, and cultural impact in a new digital frontier.

The portrait is encased in a grand gilded Baroque frame, crowned with a Medici lion wearing a royal crown, symbolizing dynastic power and sovereign rule. Flanking the portrait, two sculpted guardian lions reinforce the strength, legacy, and dominance of the Medici family. The intricate golden scrollwork surrounding the frame reflects Cosimo's architectural influence, referencing his role in shaping Florence's iconic cityscape.

A unique feature of this piece is the subtle incorporation of an American football motif, embedded within the historical composition. The inclusion of the NFL emblem at the base of the frame is a nod to Cosimo's connection to Calcio Storico, the Renaissance-era sport that evolved into modern soccer, rugby, and American football. This artistic detail highlights the Medici dynasty's lasting influence on global sports and cultural evolution.

Through Bitcoin Ordinals inscription (BRC-333) and NanoFiche archival encoding, this XFT is permanently preserved on the blockchain and in the Library of Alexandria Lunar Vault via the SpaceX Griffin Mission (2025). By integrating fine art, blockchain technology, and physical gold-bonded value, this Experiential Fungible Token (XFT) transforms Cosimo's historical portrait into an immutable digital legacy.

metadata.message: This image embodies the suffering of Syrians at every stage of their harsh journey. Each step taken by every Syrian family was heavy, as if they bore mountains of pain and suffering on their shoulders. Between the fire of war that scorches their land and the turbulent sea that awaits them, there was no safe path for any Syrian family, and no definite hope glimmering on the horizon. The suffering is not limited to this precarious tightrope they walk, fraught with danger, but exists in every moment they chose to endure the harshness of life. The war deprived every Syrian family of the safety of their homes, and the unknown threatens them with every step they take, placing them in constant confrontation with imminent death. They search for a glimmer of hope that might lighten the weight of this darkness and grant them a small measure of the lost peace.

The elements follow precise rules, creating a composition that transforms perception and generates shifting visual experiences, where the layering of patterns and colors redefines how they are observed. Inspired by synesthesia, this project explores how the mind interprets form and color when they merge into a dynamic structure.

metadata.title: Cosimo De' Medici "Calcio Fiorentino" NFL
metadata.collection: Lorenzo De' Medici Private Art Collection - Family Heritage
metadata.description:
This Cosimo De' Medici XFT is an elevated digital and physical masterpiece that honors the Grand Duke of Tuscany's legacy as a patron of the arts, a military strategist, and an architect of Florence's dominance in the Renaissance. Prince Lorenzo De' Medici merges historical iconography with contemporary elements, showcasing Cosimo's vision, power, and cultural impact in a new digital frontier.

The portrait is encased in a grand gilded Baroque frame, crowned with a Medici lion wearing a royal crown, symbolizing dynastic power and sovereign rule. Flanking the portrait, two sculpted guardian lions reinforce the strength, legacy, and dominance of the Medici family. The intricate golden scrollwork surrounding the frame reflects Cosimo's architectural influence, referencing his role in shaping Florence's iconic cityscape.

A unique feature of this piece is the subtle incorporation of an American football motif, embedded within the historical composition. The inclusion of the NFL emblem at the base of the frame is a nod to Cosimo's connection to Calcio Storico, the Renaissance-era sport that evolved into modern soccer, rugby, and American football. This artistic detail highlights the Medici dynasty's lasting influence on global sports and cultural evolution.

Through Bitcoin Ordinals inscription (BRC-333) and NanoFiche archival encoding, this XFT is permanently preserved on the blockchain and in the Library of Alexandria Lunar Vault via the SpaceX Griffin Mission (2025). By integrating fine art, blockchain technology, and physical gold-bonded value, this Experiential Fungible Token (XFT) transforms Cosimo's historical portrait into an immutable digital legacy.

metadata.Description: With this series I wanted to explore the feeling of loneliness, and a longing to form connections with others.  The first image in the series titled “Neighbour” is intended to invoke the feeling of being on the outside looking in, being drawn to the inviting warm glow of possible connections, but being unable to cross the threshold.  “Reflection” is about looking inwards, in an attempt to find an answer to a question that you can’t quite put into words.  Finally, “Transmission” is about discovering a new way in which to communicate, one that enables you to be your true authentic self, no longer alone, free from the shackles of insecurity.
metadata.History: Originally inscribed as a series of 3 pieces on Dec 11, 2023. A commissioned series for 17MILE (@crypto17mile).

metadata.Description:
Kamau and Wright are a duo of creative coders from Nairobi, Kenya. Since 2019, they have combined their technical and creative skills to build software systems and eventually ventured into generative art and NFTs mid 2021.

Since then, they have consistently put out multiple collaborative projects and works on the blockchain. This has seen them receiving recognition globally in the digital art space and even notable companies like Twitter buying into their project.

As one of the pioneers of on-chain generative art in Africa, they aim to showcase the power of code and art, preserve their culture and continue to build and pave the way for many more creators to come.

metadata.description: Synesthesis is a generative art experiment that merges synthesis and synesthesia: forms and colors are arranged within defined structures, interacting in a way that each execution gives rise to new visual relationships. The elements follow precise rules, creating a composition that transforms perception and generates shifting visual experiences, where the layering of patterns and colors redefines how they are observed. Inspired by synesthesia, this project explores how the mind interprets form and color when they merge into a dynamic structure.
